about.title: About
body: I'm a student studying software and game development, constantly learning through building apps, websites, and indie games. These projects not only fuel my creativity but also strengthen my foundation in programming and software design, which I see as essential steps toward my long-term goals.

My main direction is full stack web development: I focus on building complete web applications, from scalable back-end systems to modern, responsive front-end experiences. At the same time, I take on freelance web projects with modern tools like Astro and explore building an indie game studio. These experiences aren't my final destination, but they provide valuable real-world programming practice and help me grow toward a professional career as a full stack developer.
